screenshotManifest.method: Targeted legacy result-object export for this method only; original 750×1334 PNGs viewed individually without image modification.

visualConclusion: All nine original images were opened individually. The captured comparison rows, plan cards, annual billing explanation and reachable purchase/restore/redeem controls are readable in dark mode. English paid comparison columns are compact but no foreground text overlap or horizontal clipping was observed in these captures. Vertical movement between top and action sections is normal scrolling, not evidence that all content fits simultaneously on one screen.
limits: Many custom app labels use fixed font sizes. A passing run with the system accessibility maximum selected does not demonstrate comprehensive Dynamic Type scaling or accessibility support.
This is a Debug/local Xcode StoreKit environment. The Chinese development/simulated-payment banner is present in all languages; these are internal evidence, not App Store screenshots.
This method did not perform a purchase, restoration, offer redemption, real sandbox transaction, production legal-link visit or storefront price validation.
Coverage is one iPhone SE simulator and these three languages/states; not iPad, other devices, all app pages, all system text categories, keyboard states or physical-device performance.
No current Release build or publication approval is inferred.
No build, test execution, simulator start, settings mutation, application-code change or image editing occurred during this evidence collection.
